newsitem.title: USA: Paxson says Bloomberg news on its cable TV.
newsitem.headline: Paxson says Bloomberg news on its cable TV.

text.p: Paxson Communications Corp and Bloomberg LP said Wednesday they have a deal to air Bloomberg Television on New York WPXN-TV, Channel 31 (formerly WBIS+), for 12 hours a day.
The show will air weekdays between 0600 and 1800 Eastern time. Terms of the one year deal were not disclosed.
Paxson bought Channel 31 from Dow Jones & Co Inc and ITT Corp about a month ago for $257 million.

At a press conference at New York City Hall with Mayor Rudolph Giuliani and Paxson CEO Lowell Paxson, Bloomberg CEO Michael Bloomberg said he hopes the deal with Paxson will pave the way for his news channel getting picked up by other cable television providers in other major U.S. metro markets.
Paxson said he has filled 142 hours of weekly programming out of a possible 162 hours. The two primary sources for the programming are Bloomberg and News Corp Ltd's Liberty/Fox Sports, he said.
Paxson said he expects to close a deal with a third major programmer before he assumes operations of the station on June 30. He declined to identify the other programmer.
